data.narrative:
Astro Mechanica is a Series A-stage company in the Supersonic & Hypersonic sector, founded by Ian Brooke, having raised $27M+ to date. The addressable comp universe consists of 2 public peers (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 2 private peers (Boom Supersonic, Hermeus), though the narrow stage-specific peer set presents significant data constraints.

The Stage-Progression method is the primary applicable triangulation approach. Using the $27M total raised as a valuation proxy and applying a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical of Series A progression yields an implied valuation of $54M. This reflects the expectation of post-Series A value creation. The Peer-Median method was not applied due to insufficient same-stage or adjacent-stage comparables within the Supersonic & Hypersonic sector—only 2 narrow peers exist, below the threshold for reliable median-based inference.

The triangulated valuation range spans $46M (low) to $62M (high), anchored at a $54M median. This single-method foundation introduces material uncertainty. Key dependencies include the validity of the 2.0x multiplier as representative of stage progression for frontier-tech hardware, and the degree to which Astro Mechanica's capital efficiency and technical progress align with peer trajectories. The analysis would materially strengthen with additional comparable transaction data or clarification of Astro Mechanica's revenue stage and capital pathway to Series B.
